verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managing the full ACP and UCP checkout flows for agent platforms, with session creation that returns the UCP envelope, totals and fulfillment options. Its Agentic Cart API adds cancel and commit session steps covering pricing, stock, tax and shipping orchestration. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of an update-session or cart-modification call (only implied by 'full checkout flow'), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
